subject: 'Bad language, threats': WA politicians have had enough of copping it online
posts:
When digital platforms monetize outrage, toxic hostility replaces civil governance.
Evidence: Civil Debate, Algorithmic Abuse, Polarized Extraction
#Aletheia #AusPol

Elected leaders and political parties claim social media acts as an open digital town square where politicians must simply weather robust democratic scrutiny.
Stated Judgement: (+0.78, +0.65) — Greater Good

Online vitriol and partisan stunts have escalated into coordinated threats and harassment, driving women from public office while political actors farm the resulting outrage.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.79, -0.73) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Destruction. Weaponized toxicity degrades civic institutions while actors prioritize media engagement over public safety.
Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 11.4, z: 5)

- One Nation Attack Campaign: FAIL (-0.82, -0.76) — Exploits vitriol and personal attacks for donor clout.
- Institutional Protection: COND (-0.45, -0.32) — Law enforcement acts, but platforms evade reform.
WA MPs Andrew Hastie, Simone McGurk, and One Nation figures clashed this week over abusive social media videos and threats, as AFP teams report charging 50 individuals for harassment.

The Bright Side:
Targeted AFP taskforces and public transparency are beginning to prosecute severe criminal threats and establish legal boundaries for digital harassment.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing toxic abuse (WHAT) with legitimate scrutiny (WHO). Parties decry abusive harassment in public while continuing to produce inflammatory content.

Social Physics Analysis:
Political actors execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver: generating incendiary content to consolidate partisan power, manufacturing endless cultural battles, and externalizing safety risks onto elected representatives.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Algorithmic polarization closes systemic space for stable consensus.

The Unavoidable Truth: Escalating digital harassment directly shrinks diverse participation in public life.
The Unavoidable Lie: Calling targeted threats and misogyny normal political scrutiny.

Alethekanon:
Algorithmic architectures inherently reward grievance over problem-solving. Until platforms bear liability for targeted hostility, public service will remain an exercise in crisis management.

Awwthekanon:
No one should have to endure death threats and dehumanizing slurs just to serve their community. Public life needs more empathy and protection, not endless venom.

Brothekanon:
Parties drop inflammatory cartoons to go viral, then act shocked when comments turn toxic. You can't feed the fire all day and complain about the smoke.

Spirithekanon:
"A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger." Proverbs 15:1 FAIL
Feeding online outrage fuels mutual hostility, substituting vitriolic escalation for constructive governance.
